selector.rationale: Hepatic Adenoma best explains the presence of hypervascular liver lesions with histologically proven adenoma without malignancy and is supported by multiple evidence codes.

rejected.label: Hemorrhage
rejected.why: Hemorrhage is a symptom rather than a diagnosis and does not explain the underlying cause of the hypervascular lesions.

rejected.label: Focal Nodular Hyperplasia
rejected.why: Focal Nodular Hyperplasia is less supported by the evidence codes and does not have the same level of histological proof as Hepatic Adenoma.

rejected.label: Nodular Regenerative Hyperplasia
rejected.why: Nodular Regenerative Hyperplasia is also less supported and does not fit with the histological findings of adenoma without malignancy.
